spec_impl_deviation.root_cause: Express router registers only GET /api/health (src/routes/health.js:16). Any non-GET method on that path falls through to the catch-all 404 handler (src/server.js:34-36). There is no method-aware 405 'Method Not Allowed' handler with an Allow header.
spec_impl_deviation.spec_check: 00_health_check_system.md does not mandate a 405 response; spec §2.1 defines only GET /api/health and §9 defines a generic 404. The 405 expectation came from the Task-5 test instruction, not the spec. So this is NOT a spec violation — the app matches its spec (GET-only + generic 404).
spec_impl_deviation.functional_impact: None for the health-check contract: the endpoint is GET-only by design and read-only (spec §3.3). The non-GET request is correctly rejected without exposing internals. Monitors and load-balancers probe with GET.
spec_impl_deviation.recommendation: Optional hardening: add a 405 handler returning Allow: GET for /api/health if strict REST method semantics are desired. Backlog item — does not block Task 6 deploy.
